title: Share-copy per tone
what_it_does: One to three sentence post caption written from the video, with a fill-in pattern per tone and a rule that variants go in a separate file.
when_to_use: After every launch render, to give the person a postable caption without a second request.
why: Small, permissive, directly useful, and the rule 'specific to the project, no generic excited-to-share' is worth keeping. Only the Write share copy section is taken.
